summary: T001 attempt 1 implementation is complete and correct (requirements.lock.txt, tests/test_lockfile.py, README install sequence, unchanged pyproject.toml), but the acceptance clause 'all quality commands pass twice' is unsatisfiable from inside T001 scope because tests/test_workflow_contracts.py::test_repository_workflow_configuration_is_valid hard-codes assert config['tasks']['T001']['status'] == 'READY' while the workflow state machine correctly transitions active tasks out of READY (READY -> IN_DEVELOPMENT -> AWAITING_REVIEW). Modifying that test would exceed Developer scope and would corrupt a workflow contract invariant. Additionally, no real clean-room 'pip install --require-hashes' was performed; only pip --dry-run. The test contract defect is the primary blocker and must be resolved by a planner before any retry can pass quality gates.

triage_request.observed_problem: tests/test_workflow_contracts.py::test_repository_workflow_configuration_is_valid hard-codes assert config['tasks']['T001']['status'] == 'READY'. The workflow state machine (tools/workflow/core.py) correctly transitions every active task out of READY once prepare-develop is invoked. The conflict is observable: pytest fails identically on every active review with '1 failed' and the same hard-coded assertion message, regardless of any T001 deliverable. The Developer role cannot satisfy 'all quality commands pass twice' from inside T001 scope because (a) the test is not a T001 deliverable, (b) modifying the assertion would either weaken it to a tautology or change a workflow contract invariant the rest of the system relies on, and (c) removing the test would remove the only static check that the workflow configuration matches the documented task statuses.

tests/test_workflow_contracts.py: contains a hard-coded READY check for T001 (and likely every other task). The Developer scope is bounded by the T001 task contract, which lists only 'one import/CLI smoke test' under Deliverables — modifying contract tests is outside that scope.

tools/workflow/core.py ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS: 'READY' can only transition to 'IN_DEVELOPMENT' or 'BLOCKED'; 'IN_DEVELOPMENT' to 'AWAITING_REVIEW' / 'TRIAGE_REQUIRED' / 'BLOCKED'. The state machine is correct; the test is wrong.
triage_request.requested_change: Issue Triager should classify this as CONTRACT_MISMATCH (or SPEC_DEFECT) and route the issue to the Planner. The Planner should repair tests/test_workflow_contracts.py::test_repository_workflow_configuration_is_valid so the assertion either (a) is parameterised over the expected per-task state instead of hard-coding READY, (b) excludes the active task under test, or (c) is moved out of the static-check layer into an integration check that runs only on a fresh checkout where every task IS READY. The Planner must also decide whether the same defect exists for other tasks in the test file and apply the parallel fix. The Developer will then re-attempt T001 in a follow-up attempt to capture the missing clean-room pip install evidence.
